integrity: Proof supplies a direct integral homotopy classification. Complete finite mod-two and signed Lefschetz checks independently corroborate examples; these are not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two-independence complexes of trees with diameter at most four. Perfect m-ary special cases previously classified. Bibliographic unindexed overlap remains possible.
title: Integral homotopy and symmetry of the two-independence complexes of diameter-four trees
